$comment: Canonical machine-readable spec of the EXT-core dependency (STORY-SL-13). It is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH the artifact is checked against: the drift guard (contracts/dev-event/conformance/extcore_drift_test.go) asserts (1) this event_type set == the SL-1 contract enum in ../schema/dev-event.schema.json, and (2) every event_type here appears in openbox-core-dev-event-types.patch. Editing this file without updating the schema and the patch fails CI. Adding a type is strictly additive (INV-8).
